geography.eligibility: >=5 source-observed butterfly species and >=5 unique (datasetKey,eventDate day) combinations, on all 2010–2026 GBIF records
geography.selection_label: retrospective coverage screen, not an unbiased prospective holdout

predictor_sources.focal_GBIF_butterflies: ONLY the 30 matched GBIF-observed butterflies, not all 239
predictor_sources.WCVP: original native/current flora and resource beta fixed to PR118

primary_response: Jaccard similarity of butterfly species recorded in the exact 2010–2026 GBIF DOI, NOT true occupancy; if both region observation portfolios have zero union, pair excluded
baseline_model: M0: fixed distance/same division/temperature/aridity/native plant/native-resource similarity and WCVP flora beta; colonial duration; whole GloNAF alien Jaccard; GloNAF floristic richness min/max; GBIF provider-day min/max; GBIF dataset count min/max
extensions: M1=M0+GloNAF documented larval-host Jaccard for only the 30 recorded butterflies

evaluation.outer_holdout: leave an entire WGSRPD3 region out of training; all pairs involving it are scored, 111 folds; region-equal MSE
evaluation.primary_comparison: M1-M0 MSE reduction; M2-M0 negative control

sample_quality_sensitivity: report 2010–2017 vs 2018–2026 detection-support counts, not a temporal prediction because plants date to contemporary inventory
claims: No GBIF nonrecord is true absence
Selected 30 species are not representative of fixed 239, Americas are overrepresented
Predictor host information is not derived from GBIF observations, but still catalogued current host data
GBIF record effort and same-period plant source prevent causal/colonial-era inference
Pair-pseudo-replication is not sample size; descriptive partial correlations have no iid p-values
